newsitem.title: GERMANY: Special factors dent Fielmann results.
newsitem.headline: Special factors dent Fielmann results.

text.p: German spectacle maker Fielmann AG said on Friday the group's rapid expansion had dented first half profits but the group remained optimistic of reaching its goals for the year as a whole.
The group, which recently floated its shares, reported a 14.9 percent drop in net profits to 24.4 million marks ($16.49 million) in the first half of the year.
Group sales climbed 11.3 percent to 422.1 million marks while group external sales, including sales by franchises, rose 12.9 percent to 521.9 million marks.

Fielmann, which opened 24 new stores in the first six months of the year, said the quick expansion and high marketing costs had hit net profits. The group still plans to open another 16 stores by the end of the year.
Total marketing costs surged 52 percent to 32 million marks in the first half, the company said.
For the year as a whole, the Fielmann group forecast its net profit would be 57.1 million marks, compared with 58.3 million marks last year.
Group sales for 1996 are forecast to be 855.1 million marks compared with 772.5 million marks last year. ($1=1.4793 Mark)
